positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and maintained full-stack features for search, job detail, and application workflow experiences. 
- Developed and enhanced RESTful APIs to support responsive user-facing features and internal service integrations. 
- Improved application performance by refining data-fetching patterns, reducing unnecessary payloads, and optimizing backend response handling. 
- Partnered with product and design stakeholders to deliver iterative improvements to search and application experiences. 
- Strengthened testing, observability, and deployment practices to improve release quality and operational confidence.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built secure web applications and backend services for healthcare-related workflows, with a focus on reliability, sensitive data handling, and integration across internal and external systems.
- Designed and developed provider-facing web applications supporting claims, eligibility, and workflow management use cases. 
- Built secure REST APIs and backend services for validation, status retrieval, and data exchange across healthcare systems. 
- Developed responsive front-end interfaces for reviewing operational data, workflow status, and processing exceptions. 
- Implemented access controls, audit-friendly workflows, and maintainable service patterns for systems handling sensitive user information. 
- Mentored junior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and engineering best practices.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to full-stack development for internal operational systems, focusing on backend services, workflow automation, and web interfaces used by business and support teams.
• Built and enhanced backend services supporting order-related workflows, inventory lookups, and operational tooling.
• Developed internal web features to help users investigate exceptions, review system data, and take action on workflow issues.
• Improved service maintainability by organizing business logic more cleanly and standardizing API integration patterns.
• Supported containerized deployment and environment configuration for more reliable testing and release processes.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Worked on large-scale web applications in a service-oriented environment, building user-facing and operations-facing features with a focus on performance, maintainability, and integration with backend systems.
• Developed full-stack features for web-based workflows involving real-time updates, operational visibility, and user interactions.
• Built React-based interfaces and backend application layers to support scalable, high-volume usage.
• Improved front-end architecture by simplifying state management and streamlining data-fetching flows.
• Collaborated with engineering, product, and design teams to deliver reliable user experiences across web platforms.
• Helped improve performance and developer efficiency through refactoring and stronger component/service organization.
positions.insights: Web Engineering, Software Systems Engineering and +8 skills
